room_or_space: SECOND (MAIN) FLOOR PLAN - whole principal floor: LIVING ROOM, DINING ROOM, GUEST ROOM, KITCHEN, pantry, SERVANTS rooms, stairs, and the balconies/terraces that surround them

proportions.notable_proportion: The only written module is a 4'-0" pier-to-pier spacing, repeated identically on the kitchen north wall, the guest room west wall and the living room south wall, and visibly continued along every other window band. The living room and dining room are long, narrow spaces of identical width placed end to end on one axis, each terminating in a pointed (prow) bay; their combined length is many times their width. The service wing to the north is a second, shorter bar of similar width set parallel and offset to the east.

layout.organisation: Linear, two-bar plan with north at the top of the sheet. The principal bar runs east-west and holds the LIVING ROOM (west) and DINING ROOM (east) as one continuous space of equal width, interrupted only by a central hatched masonry core containing the fireplace and the main stair, with passage past the core on both its north and south sides. A second bar, set back to the north and overlapping the first at the stair core, holds the GUEST ROOM at its west end, then a rear stair, the KITCHEN, a pantry/serving room, an unlabelled stair, and a row of three small SERVANTS rooms off a north corridor at its east end. Both ends of the principal bar finish in pointed bays. Low walls with square urn piers define a west terrace, a long south balcony, and a large walled court to the east of the service wing.
layout.axes: One dominant longitudinal east-west axis through the living room, the central core and the dining room; a pair of long dashed (overhead) lines runs the full length of both rooms parallel to the long walls, marking a central strip along this axis. The two prow bays are symmetrical about it. A secondary, parallel east-west axis runs through the service bar. Cross axes are minor: the main stair runs north-south behind the fireplace, and the rear stair runs north-south between guest room and kitchen.
layout.entry_sequence: No exterior entrance door is drawn at this level; arrival is by stair from below. The main stair rises into the central core between the living and dining rooms (marked DOWN, descending southward behind the fireplace mass); a wooden pier and screen, drawn beside the fireplace on the living-room side, stand between the stair landing and the living room. The rear stair beside the kitchen (marked UP and DOWN) serves the service bar and has a door at its head into the guest room. From the living room's west end, doors either side of the prow bay open onto the west terrace, which steps DOWN on its north and south sides.
layout.circulation: Movement is along the long axis: living room and dining room flow past the central core on either side of the chimney mass. The service bar is reached from the dining room/stair side through the pantry-serving room beside the kitchen; the kitchen connects west to the rear stair hall and east to the pantry; the servants rooms open off a corridor along their north side, which also leads to the unlabelled stair between the pantry and the servants rooms. The south wall of both main rooms is a continuous band of glazed doors onto the south balcony; doors at the west prow lead to the west terrace; a door at the south-east corner of the dining room opens beside the end pier.
